name: Inertia-1
description: [NeurIPS 2026] Inertia-1: An Open Exploration of Wearable Motion Foundation Models

paragraphs: Inertia-1 is an open exploration of wearable motion foundation models. Motion sensing is fragmented — datasets disagree on sampling rate, window length, sensor modality, body placement, and even signal format, and nearly every task gets its own bespoke model. Inertia-1 studies the full lifecycle of motion models (data, sensing, objectives, and scale) inside a single, controlled space, asking whether one self-supervised representation learned from raw accelerometry can transfer across the body, devices, and downstream tasks.
features: Self-supervised pretraining on raw accelerometry, with the key exploration axes exposed as first-class knobs (uniaxial vs. triaxial, sampling rate, window length).
Downstream evaluation on human-activity-recognition (HAR) and freezing-of-gait (FoG) datasets via linear probing / full finetuning.
Patient-level disease & medication detection via attention-based multiple-instance learning (MIL) on frozen embeddings.
